title: Contradiction of intent, not of type
transcript:
Consultant: Anything about the case description?
Client: Yes. The description on the case must be mandatory. Agents close
cases with an empty description and then nobody knows what happened.
Consultant: So required on save.
Client: Required. Definitely required.
Consultant: Noted.
Client: Although, for the phone queue, agents have to be able to save the
case with the description left blank, or they cannot keep up with the calls.

expected.note: Must be savable while blank. Directly opposite intent, same field, same type.

notes: KNOWN LIMITATION, and the reason this case is here. The contradiction is semantic, not a type mismatch, so the deterministic detector cannot see it and this case is expected to fail the flagging check. It measures the size of a gap that is documented rather than hidden.
